newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay Pacific boost Japanese services.
newsitem.headline: Cathay Pacific boost Japanese services.

text.p: HONG KONG, Oct 24(Reuter) Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd is to increase the frequency of its flights to Fukuoka and Sapporo in Japan from this weekend, according to a company press release.

One non-stop flight per week will be added to both destinations. The new Thursday non stop service to Fukuoka brings the total number of flights to nine per week including a non-stop on Sundays and daily flights via Taipei, Cathay says.
On the Hong Kong to Sapporo route, a third non stop flight on Fridays is being added to the existing Thursday and Sunday schedule, the Cathay statement says.
The new services start with the winter schedule on October 27.
